name: Signal Jammer - Armor
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Armor capability.

61177.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Armor
61177.SpecificEffects:

In combat, the enemy's Armor <color=#F74848>-50%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
